sources.title: PacLII, Laws of the Republic of Vanuatu, Consolidated Edition 2006, Public Holidays Act [Cap. 114], as archive.org's snapshot of 29 January 2025 holds it
sources.said: 1. Public holidays The days stated in the Schedule shall be public holidays. 2. President may declare other public holidays The President acting on the advice of the Prime Minister may from time to time declare other days as public holidays. 3. Public holidays falling on Sundays When any of the days stated is a Sunday the following Monday shall be a public holiday and when Family Day falls upon a Monday the day following shall be a public holiday. ... SCHEDULE (Section 1) New Year's Day Lini Day (21 February) Custom Chief's Day (5 March) Good Friday Easter Monday Labour Day (1 May) Ascension Day Children’s National Day (24 July) Independence Day Assumption Day National Unity Day (5 October) Constitution Day (29 November) Christmas Day Family Day ... Schedule Amended by Acts 17 of 1993, 50 of 2005
sources.note: The 2006 consolidation (amendments to Act 50 of 2005), saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/vu-pha163.html from the snapshot's raw form; PacLII itself answers with a Cloudflare challenge (not passed). A later amendment wasn't found (Parliament's acts page links PacLII's annual lists, which weren't read past 2005).

sources.title: Government of Vanuatu (OGCIO), Holidays, as archive.org's snapshot of 11 June 2026 holds it
sources.said: National Holiday 1 January New Years day / Nouvel An National Holiday 21 February In Memory of the "Fr. of Independence" Fr.Dr.W.H.Lini National Holiday 5 March Custom Chief's Day / Fete des Chefs coutumiers National Holiday 10 April Good Friday / Vendredi Saint National Holiday 13 April Easter Monday National Holiday 1 May Labour Day / Fete due Travail National Holiday 21 May Ascension Provincial Holiday 18 June Shefa Day National Holiday 24 July Children's Day / Journee Mondiale des Enfants National Holiday 30 July Independence day /Jour de independence National Holiday 15 August Assumption day / Fete de l'assomption Provincial Holiday 16 September Penama Day Provincial Holiday 24 September Sanma Day Provincial Holiday 2 October Torba Day National Holiday 5 October Constitution day / Fete de la Constitution Provincial Holiday 8 October Tafea Day Provincial Holiday 10 October Malampa Day National Holiday 29 November Unity Day / Fete de l'Unite National Holiday 25 December Christmas Day / Fete de Noel National Holiday 26 December Family day / Fete de Famille
sources.note: Saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/vu-holidays.html. The live page answered with the same table on 2026-10-30. Its movable days are 2020's (Good Friday 10 April, Ascension 21 May), so the table is read for its fixed days and the provincial days only. The Act gives the national days and the Sunday rule; the Government's page gives the same days and each province's own. Readings: the Act's Schedule pairs 5 October with National Unity Day and 29 November with Constitution Day, the Government's page the other way round; the names here are the page's, the dates the same either way. The provincial days are kept only in their province (Shefa VU.18, Penama VU.17, Sanma VU.13, Torba VU.07, Tafea VU.15, Malampa VU.16) and, being outside the Act's Schedule, aren't moved off a Sunday; neither source says by what act they are held. Section 3's Sunday rule is kept as the next day that isn't already a holiday, which gives its Family Day case (Christmas on a Sunday: Monday and Tuesday). Days the President declares under section 2 (none for 2026 read) aren't kept. The lists are the rules' days for 2026.
